## OSIRIS-REx’s Bennu Sample Exceeded Its 60-Gram Minimum

OSIRIS-REx returned material from asteroid Bennu to Earth on September 24, 2023. The mission required at least 60 grams of sample, and that minimum had already been exceeded before the sampling head was completely opened.

A final pour added 51.2 grams. The completed inventory totaled 121.6 grams—well above the 60-gram requirement.
